_readme: Example subtitle language file. Only files named with a Minecraft language code, such as de_de.json, are loaded.
To translate: in config/villager-news-addon-port/subtitles copy en_us.json and name the copy <code>.json,
set "language" to the name shown in the Villager News settings, and translate every line in "subtitles" without changing the keys.
Each key is <dialogue>.<variant>.<part>. Parts with the same dialogue and variant are shown one after another, so keep each part in its own key.
"names" is optional. It renames villagers without a name tag in front of their subtitles, for example Farmer or Wandering Trader.
Lines you leave out are shown in English. Choose Auto in the settings to follow the game language.
Optional: ai_translation_prompt.md in this folder is a ready-made prompt for AI coding assistants that drafts a full translation.
